#Hobo.Face.scared
Hobo: O-Ow!{{punch}} Why would you do that?!
You: I’m done playing with you. Get the hell out of here, little buddy.
You: You lot too. Get the hell out of there!
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Come on, guys! Help me! If we all jump him we will win for sure!
???: …
Hobo: W-What are you waiting for?! Get him!
???: Don’t wanna.
Hobo: What do you mean you don’t wanna?! He’s the enemy! 
???: He seems scary, it’s not worth it. Let’s leave, everyone.
Hobo: W-What?! You can’t leave me! W-Wait! Wait!
